flow_feature_source: flow_feature_source: CYBERMIND custom directional packet exporter; 40-column schema; satisfies the project's 20-field packet-feature contract when verified, but is not CICFlowMeter and omits approximately 67 of the pinned CICFlowMeter traffic-statistic columns. No CICFlowMeter feature parity is claimed.
flow_semantics: directional IPv4 sessions; 300-second inactivity timeout; no biflow merge
non_ipv4_and_fragment_policy: excluded and counted; no reassembly or invented transport tuple
offload_record_policy: IPv4 total-length zero is accepted only for complete TCP capture records (captured length equals wire length) with a full TCP header; total length is derived from captured IP bytes, records are counted, and source bytes remain unchanged.
